name: Clutter
description: On a synthetic test tree these 2-plane cards looked worse than the default crossed cards from oblique and ground-level views; check on your own objects. Small objects cost 8 triangles each: 2 crossed cards with a 256 px picture. Identical copies are baked once.
select_hint: Select the bushes, rocks or signs, not the ground they stand on. Compare with the default crossed cards first.
